title: Failure probability for junta testing
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let the target be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$, and suppose it depends on at most $k$ coordinates. For every failure parameter $\delta\in(0,1/2]$, the probability that the constant-testing program returns an incorrect decision about whether the target is a constant sign function is at most $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: The target is a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$
The target depends on some set of at most $k$ coordinates
